name: Farthest Point Sampling (FPS)
aliases: Point Cloud Downsampling via Farthest Point Sampling
definition: A method that operates in continuous Euclidean space, defining convolution weights at specific kernel points influenced by a linear correlation function.
summary: Farthest Point Sampling is an iterative algorithm that downsamples point clouds by selecting points maximally spread in Euclidean space to ensure uniform spatial coverage.
